name: Kei
source:
Birthplace: Kibi Province
Sword: Raikiri & Kazakiri
Style: Ushitora

A samurai who wields dual swords. He came to Edo from Kibi Province, in order to join the Imperial Tournament of Sword Retrieval and win the Five Heavenly Swords. He makes a living by working as a roundsman, protecting Edo’s security. He’s aggressive and has a bad mouth. He’s also clumsy, in the sense that he can’t be honest to the people he doesn’t respect. However, he’s actually a kind man who will turn protective upon getting relied on.

[from [url=http://kokoronodamu.tumblr.com/post/36202686560/ken-ga-kimi-character-profiles/]kokoronodamu[/url]]
